sourceSteps: 面朝墙壁或坚固物体站立，距离大约一臂远。
将手放在与肩同高的墙壁或物体上。
一只脚向后退一步，保持脚跟平放在地面上。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直。
您应该感觉到小腿肌肉有拉伸感。
observation: Fixed wall-paw contact and split stance, rear heel planted and rear knee straight; gentle front-knee flexion/forward lean. Single-side short preview, not a 20-30 second prescribed hold.
scope: One reversible movement preview; return will only be exact reversal after forward-phase review. Stretch timing and one-side examples do not claim a full prescribed hold or both sides.

semanticRelationship.relationship: Same hands-on-wall rear-calf stretch technique; this candidate must not be counted alongside a second equivalent ready1377 as another distinct new movement.
